name: PatchMon Panel
author: tug-benson
description: PatchMon fleet status in your Omarchy bar: total hosts, pending updates, reboots, connectivity and a derived security score, with a drill-down panel.

barWidget.description: Shows PatchMon fleet health and lets you drill into per-host status.

schema.label: Integration API token key
schema.description: Token Key from Settings -> Integrations -> API (host:get scope)

schema.label: Integration API token secret
schema.description: Token Secret (shown once at creation). Stored only in your local shell.json.

schema.label: Host group filter (optional)
schema.description: Only show hosts in this PatchMon host group

schema.label: Stale after (minutes)
schema.description: A host whose last check-in is older than this is shown as Offline/Stale. PatchMon's Integration API does not expose reporting_state, so connectivity is derived from last_update recency (default 24h).
